# Principia Robotica

> The World's First Deterministic Safety Gateway for Embodied AI — Active Control Barrier Function (CBF-QP) and Lyapunov stability filter guaranteeing collision-free physical actuation at >12,000 Hz.

## Documentation
- [Executive Overview](README.md): Architecture, zero-trust safety gateway, problem formulation, and visual showcase.
- [Mathematical Theory & Formal Proofs](docs/THEORY.md): Control Barrier Functions, forward set invariance, Lie derivatives, KKT optimality proofs, and Lyapunov stability.
- [AI Client Integration Matrix](README.md#ai-client-integration-setup-matrix): Stdio MCP configuration for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Antigravity IDE, and Windsurf.
- [Performance Benchmarks](docs/BENCHMARKS.md): Throughput profiling (>12,000 Hz), latency distributions, and solver comparisons.

## Architecture & Key Concepts
- [Active CBF-QP Filter](README.md#mathematical-architecture--formal-proofs): Quadratic programming optimization minimizing L2 control perturbation subject to forward invariance.
- [Closed-Form Unicycle CBF](README.md#closed-form-analytical-unicycle-safety-barrier): Analytical scalar projection for circular obstacle avoidance in <0.01 ms.
- [CLF-CBF-QP Co-Design](README.md#clf-cbf-qp-co-design-with-relaxation-slack): Joint Lyapunov goal tracking and hard safety invariance via slack relaxation delta >= 0.
- [Multibody Dynamics & Passivity](README.md#multibody-dynamics--skew-symmetric-passivity-invariant): Euler-Lagrange equations, positive-definite inertia, and skew-symmetric passivity property.
- [Denavit-Hartenberg Forward Kinematics](README.md#denavit-hartenberg-dh-forward-kinematics-formulation): Link transformation matrices A_i and end-effector pose T_n^0.
- [Geometric Jacobian & DLS Pseudoinverse](README.md#geometric-jacobian--damped-least-squares-dls-pseudoinverse): Singularity-robust damped inverse and manipulability gradient null-space projection.

## APIs & Tools
- [cbf_filter_velocity](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): Filters proposed unicycle (v, omega) commands against surrounding obstacles.
- [predict_safe_trajectory](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): 1000Hz fast-forward kinematic trajectory pre-simulation and certification.
- [lyapunov_stability_check](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): Real-time candidate Lyapunov function and derivative convergence certifier.
- [cbf_quadrotor_altitude](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): Altitude floor constraint filter for quadrotor thrust commands.
- [minimal_perturbation_proof](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): Generates formal KKT optimality proof of minimal L2 control deviation.
- [clf_cbf_qp_solver](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): Combined CLF-CBF solver with slack variable delta >= 0.
- [swarm_cbf_fleet_safety](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): Pairwise Euclidean separation distance enforcement for multi-robot fleets.
- [dynamic_obstacle_cbf](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): Dynamic obstacle filter incorporating explicit time derivative dh/dt.
- [get_cbf_spatial_map](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): 2D ASCII spatial polar radar visualization for LLM context windows.
- [batch_cbf_filter](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): Parallel batch velocity filtering for multi-robot swarms.
- [get_cbf_safety_report](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): Complete state safety audit across all active barrier functions.
- [principia_benchmark](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): Automated latency profiling across 500 QP solves.
- [principia_ui](README.md#13-major-work-feature-demonstrations): Local launcher for 60 FPS HTML5 Canvas dashboard.
